templates.pattern: In 6×6 Sudoku, row has [A], [B], ?, [C], [D], [E]. Uses 1-6. What's position 3?
templates.explanation: Row uses 1-6 (sum=21). Missing = 21 - [A] - [B] - [C] - [D] - [E]

templates.pattern: Cell (3,4) constraints: Row has [A],[B]. Column has [C],[D]. Box has [E]. Uses 1-6. What fits?
templates.explanation: Blocked by [A],[B] in row, [C],[D] in column, [E] in box. Remaining number from 1-6

templates.pattern: 9-cell box has [A], [B], [C], [D], [E], ?, ?, ?, ?. Uses 1-9. Sum of missing 4 numbers?
templates.explanation: Box uses 1-9 (sum=45). Has 5 numbers. Missing sum = 45 - [A] - [B] - [C] - [D] - [E]

templates.pattern: X-Sudoku: Main diagonal has [A], ?, [B], [C]. Uses 1-4. No repeats. What's position 2?
templates.explanation: Diagonal uses 1-4 once. Missing = 10 - [A] - [B] - [C]

templates.pattern: Killer Sudoku cage: [A] + [B] + ? = [SUM]. Uses 1-9, no repeats. What's ?
templates.explanation: Cage sum is [SUM]. Has [A] and [B]. Missing = [SUM] - [A] - [B]

templates.pattern: Row and column intersection: Row needs [A] or [B]. Column needs [B] or [C]. What's at intersection?
templates.explanation: Row needs [A] or [B]. Column needs [B] or [C]. Common is [B]

templates.pattern: 3×2 box in 6×6 grid has [A], [B], [C], ?, ?, ?. Uses 1-6. What's the sum of missing 3?
templates.explanation: Box uses 1-6 (sum=21). Has [A], [B], [C]. Missing sum = 21 - A - B - C

templates.pattern: Diagonal Sudoku: Both diagonals use 1-9. Main diagonal has [A], ?, [B], [C], [D], [E], [F], [G], [H]. What's position 2?
templates.calculation: 45 - A - B - C - D - E - F - G - H
templates.explanation: Diagonal uses 1-9 (sum=45). Missing = 45 - all given numbers

templates.pattern: Cell has 3 constraints: Can't be [A] (row), [B] (column), [C] (box), [D] (region). Uses 1-5. What fits?
templates.explanation: Blocked by 4 numbers. Uses 1-5. Remaining = 15 - A - B - C - D

templates.pattern: Hyper Sudoku: Extra box has [A], [B], [C], ?. Also in row with [D]. Uses 1-4. What fits?
templates.explanation: Box has [A],[B],[C]. Row has [D]. All different, so 10 - A - B - C - D

templates.pattern: Consecutive constraint: Cell must be ±1 of [N]. Column has [A], [B]. Uses 1-9. What works?
templates.explanation: Must be [N]-1 or [N]+1. Column blocks [A] and [B]. Find valid option

templates.pattern: Odd-Even Sudoku: Cell must be odd. Row has [A], [B]. Column has [C]. Uses 1-9. What odd number fits?
templates.explanation: Must be odd (1,3,5,7,9). Row blocks [A],[B]. Column blocks [C]. Find remaining odd

templates.pattern: Samurai Sudoku overlap: Cell in 2 grids. Grid1 row has [A], [B]. Grid2 column has [C]. Uses 1-9. What fits?
templates.calculation: 45 - A - B - C and find valid
templates.explanation: Grid1 blocks [A],[B]. Grid2 blocks [C]. Need number not in these

templates.pattern: Arrow Sudoku: Arrow sum = circle. Circle has ?. Arrow cells are [A] and [B]. What's circle value?
templates.explanation: Circle = sum of arrow cells. Circle = [A] + [B]

templates.pattern: Thermometer Sudoku: Cells increase along thermometer. Has [A], ?, [C]. [A] < ? < [C]. Uses 1-9. What's ?
templates.explanation: Must be between [A] and [C]. Middle value logically fits

templates.pattern: Sandwich Sudoku: Sum between 1 and 9 in row is [SUM]. Cells between: ?, [B], [C]. What's ?
templates.explanation: Sum between 1 and 9 is [SUM]. Has [B] and [C]. Missing = [SUM] - [B] - [C]

templates.pattern: Greater-than constraint: Cell A > Cell B. A is [X]. B could be [Y] or [Z]. Is this valid?
templates.calculation: IF X > Y AND X > Z THEN yes ELSE no
templates.explanation: [X] > [Y]? [X] > [Z]? Check both

templates.pattern: Anti-Knight Sudoku: Cell can't be [N] (knight's move away). Row needs [A] or [N]. What fits?
templates.explanation: Row needs [A] or [N]. Anti-knight blocks [N]. Must be [A]

templates.pattern: Kropki Sudoku: White dot means consecutive. Cells with white dot: [A] and ?. [A]=4. What's ?
templates.explanation: White dot = consecutive. If [A]=4, then ? is 3 or 5

templates.pattern: XV Sudoku: X means sum=10. Cells with X: [A] and ?. What's ?
templates.explanation: X means sum is 10. [A] + ? = 10. So ? = 10 - [A]

templates.pattern: Clone Sudoku: Two grids mirror. Grid1 cell has [A]. Same position Grid2 has ?. What's in Grid2?
templates.explanation: Clone grids are identical. Grid1 has [A], so Grid2 has [A]

templates.pattern: Windoku: 4 extra boxes. Box2 has [A], [B], [C], ?. Also shares row with [D]. Uses 1-4. What's ?
templates.calculation: 10 - A - B - C - D if valid
templates.explanation: Box has [A],[B],[C]. Row has [D]. All unique, so 10 - A - B - C - D

templates.pattern: Irregular Sudoku: Region has [A], [B], [C], [D], ?. Uses 1-5. What completes region?
templates.explanation: Region uses 1-5 (sum=15). Missing = 15 - [A] - [B] - [C] - [D]

templates.pattern: Jigsaw Sudoku: Shaped region has [A], [B], ?, [D], [E], [F]. Uses 1-6. What's position 3?
templates.explanation: Region uses 1-6 (sum=21). Missing = 21 - [A] - [B] - [D] - [E] - [F]

templates.pattern: Multi-constraint: Cell must be > [X], odd, not in column ([A], [B]), uses 1-9. What fits?
templates.calculation: Odd, > X, not A or B
templates.explanation: Must be odd, greater than [X], not [A] or [B]. Find valid odd number
